summary: Promise resolving functions ignore every resolve/reject call after the first effective resolution, including when locked to another pending promise.

target.notes: The helper must distinguish resolved from settled: resolving with another pending promise locks the outcome immediately.

semantics.resolved_pending: possible when adopting a pending promise

caveats: A promise can be resolved but still pending; mapping resolved directly to Task completion is incorrect.

tests.name: adoption locks before adopted promise settles
tests.expected_behavior: fulfills with 8; later reject call has no effect
